reason: 该插件的核心用途是为 DSH Web 的右侧栏提供 Excel 文件编辑能力：读取 .xlsx、进行单元格/样式/公式编辑并保存回源文件。证据来自 README、仓库描述与包清单，功能点集中在表格文档处理和前后端联动，而非通用自动化或外部服务集成，因此归类为文档处理类插件。

summaries.zh: 这是一个在 DSH 右侧栏打开和编辑 .xlsx 文件的插件，提供单元格编辑、公式实时计算、格式设置以及将修改保存回原文件的功能。
summaries.en: This plugin lets you open and edit .xlsx files in the DSH right sidebar, with cell editing, live formula updates, formatting controls, and saving changes back to the original file.

capabilities: Read and parse .xlsx files for display and editing in a side-panel interface
Support cell editing, formatting, merges, row/column operations, and sheet management in a spreadsheet UI
Evaluate formulas and update results in real time
Persist changes by rebuilding and writing xlsx files back to the source file
Expose backend routes for read/write/unlock actions

reasons.code: README describes backend routes /excel-panel/read and /excel-panel/write for parsing and rebuilding .xlsx files, showing direct file content read/write behavior.
README and repository description consistently identify the plugin as a DSH 右侧栏 Excel 编辑插件 that supports preview/edit and save-back workflow for .xlsx files.
package.json declares a DSH web plugin entry with an Excel-focused backend dependency (exceljs), matching spreadsheet file processing behavior.
Tree listing includes lib/index.js and lib/client.js, indicating a backend/frontend split for handling spreadsheet operations.
